name: natural_language_routing
objective: Evaluate whether MainAgentOrchestrator safely converts natural language messages into allowed internal commands.

route_accuracy.description: Positive examples routed to the expected command and argument.

rejection_accuracy.description: Negative examples rejected with no route.

cross_channel_rejection.description: LLM responses that pick a command unavailable in the current Discord channel are rejected.

low_confidence_rejection.description: LLM responses below NATURAL_LANGUAGE_ROUTING_CONFIDENCE are rejected.

invalid_argument_rejection.description: Malformed kitchen action arguments are rejected.

constraints: Do not call DeepSeek during this offline eval.
Do not call Discord, COROS MCP, Bilibili, or the filesystem data stores.
Evaluate the router post-processing and safety gates using fixed LLM route outputs.
Running channel may only route to coros, running, feel, or feelings.
Cooking channel may only route to kitchen.
